entities.name: Domenico de Dominicis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Domenico de' Domenichi or Domenico de Dominicis was a Roman Catholic prelate who served as Bishop of Brescia (1464–1478)
and Bishop of Torcello (1448–1464).
